name: hermes-agent
description: Nous Research Hermes Agent (autonomous, persistent-memory AI agent) on oci-apps. Messaging gateway (Telegram live, Mattermost scaffolded) backed by claude-superset-api (subscription CLI, no metered key). WG-internal, never public.

agent._comment: Shared git checkout (docker volume cloud-git-gh), mounted by _shared/engine.nix. Mount point is this container's own $HOME/git: getent passwd 10000 -> hermes:x:10000:10000::/opt/data:/bin/sh, so HOME is /opt/data and the tree belongs at /opt/data/git. Read-only: hermes is a chat gateway that reads code, it does not commit. Flip git_tree_writable to true to change that.
